title: Machu Picchu When People Lived There
description: What life looked like at the Inca emperor's mountain estate around 1450.

scenes.narration: Imagine waking up here every morning, nearly two and a half kilometres up, in the clouds.
scenes.image_prompt: Machu Picchu at sunrise above the clouds, thatched roofs on stone houses, Andes peaks

scenes.narration: It's around 1450. The Inca emperor Pachacuti has built a royal estate high in the Andes of Peru.
scenes.image_prompt: Inca emperor in gold and feathered headdress overlooking a mountain estate with nobles

scenes.narration: Stone walls fit together so tightly that you can't slide a knife between the blocks.
scenes.image_prompt: close up of perfectly fitted Inca stone wall blocks without mortar, morning light

scenes.narration: Terraces climb the mountainsides, growing crops and stopping landslides.
scenes.image_prompt: green Inca agricultural terraces on steep slopes with farmers and llamas

scenes.narration: Hundreds of people live and work here, serving the emperor's household.
scenes.image_prompt: Inca people weaving colourful textiles and cooking inside a stone village, llamas nearby

scenes.narration: Fresh water flows in through stone channels from a mountain spring.
scenes.image_prompt: stone water channel and fountain in an Inca city, clear water flowing

scenes.narration: Within about a hundred years, the site is abandoned. The Spanish never find it.
scenes.image_prompt: empty overgrown Inca ruins covered in jungle and mist

scenes.narration: It became world famous in 1911. Would you climb all the way up here? Comment below.
scenes.image_prompt: Machu Picchu today with Huayna Picchu mountain behind, bright day
